info.name: ERP Purchasing Microservice API
info.description: Production-grade Postman collection covering all P2P domain workflows: Requisitions, Sourcing & RFQs, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts (GRN), Vendor Bills & 3-Way Matching, Purchase Returns, Analytics, Transactional Outbox, System Health, and Prometheus Metrics.
